context.transcript:
Hello, my name is Liang Chen.
Thank you for inviting me to audition for the solo cello position in the Springville Orchestra.
I have selected to play for you a few short pieces that I hope will give you a good idea of the range of my musical ability.
I'm also handing out a list of my references to each member of the interview panel.
Now, I will begin with a short selection of classical cello music.
context.transcript_translation:
大家好，我叫 Liang Chen。
感谢邀请我来参加 Springville Orchestra 的独奏大提琴职位试镜。
我挑选了几首短曲子为您演奏，希望能够让您了解我的音乐能力范围。
我还将向面试小组的每位成员分发一份我的推荐人名单。
现在，我将从一段古典大提琴音乐选段开始。
